description: Current video anomaly dataset collection: ShanghaiTech, Avenue, and NWPU.

extension_policy.add_dataset: Create a new sibling dataset folder and register it here.
extension_policy.add_scheme: Create a new folder under schemes and register it here.
extension_policy.large_payload_policy: Keep concrete frames, videos, detections, tracks, visualizations, and model outputs locally inside this collection, but do not commit those large payloads to Git.

local_payload_policy.closure_goal: Dataset folders should be usable without relying on external source paths once preparation is complete.
local_payload_policy.git_policy: Git tracks metadata, schemes, scripts, and documentation only. Large payload directories are ignored.
